title: Boyfriend Gets Arrested for His BRUTAL Assault on Sleeping Girlfriend
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 2nd, 2023. Officers were dispatched to a residence regarding a woman who had just been brutally attacked by her boyfriend. The woman said she was asleep and then suddenly felt her boyfriend choking her after going through her phone and finding text messages of her cheating on him. The boyfriend also started destroying her property with box cutters. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
